title: Image rights & provenance
description: Source, authorship, licence and processing records for images used across the BHOC Veterinary and BHOC Species & Biodiversity Protection Initiative websites.
policy: Individual photo credits are kept off the main BHOC Veterinary and Initiative compositions. This separate register preserves the source, creator, licence, verification date, processing history and reason for every displayed image.
rightsBoundary: Third-party terms apply only to the underlying photographs identified below. They do not license the surrounding BHOC text, branding, scientific materials, layout, design or code. No photographer, source platform or public agency is represented as endorsing BHOC or this Initiative.

The result was then encoded as lossless WebP with zero differing pixels and continues to be cropped responsively into separate wolf and comparison panels.
